title: The Lost Provision
author: Jude Sterling
blurb: Elodie Marchetti, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, keeps moving because stopping costs more. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
